newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Le Pen swears in talking postcard.
newsitem.headline: France's Le Pen swears in talking postcard.

text.p: France's extreme-right National Front launched a talking postcard on Monday in which anti-immigration crusader Jean-Marie Le Pen swears at voters in an election campaign gimmick.
The postcard, which the party plans to distribute in cafes and bars ahead of next Sunday's first round of a parliamentary election, shows Le Pen gagged by the political establishment.

When the card is pressed, a recording of Le Pen's voice says: "What about France, goddamit? Do you think about it? It's high time. Tomorrow will be too late. So go to the polls, citizens, and vote FN (National Front)."
Le Pen's number two, Bruno Megret, told reporters the card was "just a gimmick for cafe counters".
